mapper.sql: member_id, cn_name, en_name, member_desc,profession,direction, email,ct_type,serial_num, avatar_url, outside_url, inside_url, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT mc.`ct_type`, mc.`ct_zh_name`, mc.`sort`, m.member_id, m.cn_name, m.en_name, m.member_desc, m.profession, m.direction, m.email, m.serial_num, m.avatar_url, m.outside_url, m.inside_url, m.create_time, m.update_time, me.cohort_year, me.cohort_label, me.program_type, me.degree_type, me.graduation_destination FROM `og_members_category` AS mc INNER JOIN `og_member_category_rel` AS mcr ON mcr.`ct_type` = mc.`ct_type` AND mcr.`is_visible` = 1 INNER JOIN `og_members` AS m ON m.`member_id` = mcr.`member_id` LEFT JOIN `og_member_education` AS me ON me.`member_id` = m.`member_id` AND ((mcr.`ct_type` = 'phd' AND me.`degree_type` = 'phd') OR (mcr.`ct_type` = 'graduate_student' AND me.`degree_type` = 'master') OR (mcr.`ct_type` = 'graduate')) ORDER BY mc.`sort` ASC, me.`cohort_year` ASC, mcr.`serial_num` ASC, m.`serial_num` ASC

SELECT m.member_id, m.cn_name, m.en_name, m.member_desc, m.profession, m.direction, m.email, COALESCE(mcr.ct_type, m.ct_type) AS ct_type, m.serial_num, m.avatar_url, m.outside_url, m.inside_url, m.create_time, m.update_time, me.cohort_year, me.cohort_label, me.program_type, me.degree_type, me.graduation_destination FROM og_members m LEFT JOIN og_member_category_rel mcr ON mcr.member_id = m.member_id AND mcr.is_primary = 1 LEFT JOIN og_member_education me ON me.member_id = m.member_id AND ((COALESCE(mcr.ct_type, m.ct_type) = 'phd' AND me.degree_type = 'phd') OR (COALESCE(mcr.ct_type, m.ct_type) = 'graduate_student' AND me.degree_type = 'master') OR (COALESCE(mcr.ct_type, m.ct_type) = 'graduate')) WHERE m.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY me.update_time DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO og_member_category_rel (member_id, ct_type, is_primary, is_visible, serial_num) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{ctType}, 1, 1, COALESCE(#{serialNum}, 0)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_primary = 1, is_visible = 1, serial_num = VALUES(serial_num), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM og_member_education WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND degree_type = #{degreeType}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO og_member_education (member_id, degree_type, cohort_year, cohort_label, program_type, graduation_destination, display_order) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{degreeType}, #{cohortYear}, #{cohortLabel}, #{programType}, #{graduationDestination}, COALESCE(#{displayOrder}, 0))
